capabilities: Navigate vault link trees entirely by keyboard
Announce link summaries and actions via ARIA live regions and earcons
Curate a Deck of selected notes for reordering, deletion and copying
Toggle and drill into incoming and outgoing links
Detect and open orphan notes with no links
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a visual graph renderer; it presents link structure as keyboard-navigable text trees with audio feedback.
extras: The README includes a full Turkish translation of the documentation.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's default visual Graph view locks 2D spatial data into a visual canvas
motivation: The author built it because the default Graph view locks 2D spatial data into a visual canvas, excluding screen-reader users and slowing keyboard-centric power users.
problem: Obsidian's visual Graph view locks link data into a graphical canvas, excluding screen-reader users and slowing keyboard-only navigation.
summary: Keyboard-first graph exploration workstation that replaces the visual Graph view with a 3-pane ARIA interface, TTS announcements, earcons, and orphan note detection.
